title: Scan-run completion envelope (v1)
description: Closes a scan run and, optionally, reconciles the scopes it enumerated. Reconciliation is the ONLY mechanism by which an object can be marked absent, and it is permitted only for a run that succeeded with no errors and was not incremental. A partial or failed run therefore cannot delete anything: unseen is not the same as gone.

status.description: succeeded: every declared scope was fully enumerated. partial: usable observations, incomplete coverage. failed: coverage unknown. canceled: stopped deliberately.

batch_count.description: Number of batches the collector sent. The server compares this with what it received and downgrades the run to partial on a mismatch.

errors.description: Failures encountered during the run. An unreadable object is reported here, never silently omitted: access the collector could not observe is unobserved, not absent.

reconciled_scopes.description: Scopes this run enumerated completely. Objects in these scopes that the run did not report may be marked absent. Must be a subset of the scopes declared at start, and must be empty unless status is 'succeeded' with error_count 0.

affirmation_count.description: Contract 1.4. How many affirmations the collector sent, counted the way observation_count counts observations.

checkpoint.description: Contract 1.4. The cursor the next delta may resume from. Permitted ONLY on a run whose status is 'succeeded' with no errors. A partial run did not read everything below its watermark, so a cursor placed there would make the next delta start above exactly the objects this run failed on - a gap that closes only by accident, because nothing afterwards looks missing. The server refuses one on a run it downgraded for short delivery, for the same reason.

errors.message: READ_CONTROL denied reading the security descriptor.
